topic: What if you could switch off sleep?
part: Chapter 1 of 6: cold open and title card (long-form, ~40 s)
title: WHAT IF YOU COULD
SWITCH OFF SLEEP?

power.rule: one flip and you never feel tired again (it switches off feeling tired, not being tired)
power.look: offLook: the lamp dies, the room's light goes cold, the hero's eyes glow in the dark, an OFF chip

script.text: Three a.m. Your whole city is asleep.
Homework due at eight? Off. Done by four.
Your cat wakes up to judge you. You never went to bed.
What if you could switch off sleep?
One flip, and you never feel tired again. Not once. Not ever.

shots.note: the bedside clock reads 3:00, the lamp's glow beside it
the whole room at night, the city asleep in the window; you sit up in bed, wide awake
you in bed turn to us: not you
your hand flips the lamp's switch: Off. The lamp dies
your face in the dark, cold light, your eyes glowing; cool
first period: you at your desk, a huge yawn, tired
you flick an invisible switch at your temple: Off. Eyes glow, you sit up straight, cool
homework due at eight: a tall blank stack, the clock at 11:58, you slump
Off: sheets fly through, every one done, stack lands; the clock flips to 4:00
the cat on the counter wakes up and stares, judging
you at the island, dressed, a mug, eyes glowing; you raise the mug to the cat
WHAT IF YOU COULD / SWITCH OFF SLEEP? over the dark bedroom, OFF pulses
you, lamp off, smug, eyes glowing; music comes in
you sit on the made bed in the dark, awake; the clock rolls on and on
